title: Existing birthday source refresh and gift planning review

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Page the bound calendar broadly before filtering recipients; use bound Todoist gift history as durable authority, not Personal Hub.
Use birthday_check.py after one fresh-source refresh; reuse verified same-day complete evidence and preserve exact date/name or confirmed alias crosswalk.
Include a recipient only with existing gift-history record or prior user-confirmed family evidence; calendar-only names grant no research, reporting, task or add permission.
Previously confirmed family records missing from calendar remain reconciliation holds; retain confirmed dates privately until actual corrected source evidence.

User-facing scope is upcoming family birthdays within 30 days or confirmed recipients missing history; omit recorded past and unrelated birthdays. Upcoming covered gifts may receive only a brief useful mention.
Preserve current-year interests, budget, size, exclusions and preferred name spelling; unanswered adult-child interests or grandchild-parent questions go to the user, never automatic contacts.
When a separately verified research continuation is available, offer 3-5 current linked/priced choices, books first and a strong book option when appropriate.

After actual user choice, a separate authorized write continuation may update the undated history and one action due seven days before the birthday; preserve exact item details and recheck-price/delivery note.
Only confirmed exact-occurrence sent/purchased evidence closes an action; selected/planned/pending or prior-year records cannot.
Current-window unknown prevents all-clear; the native flexible morning band is not an exact clock. Resolve actual executor, timezone and destination trial.

success_checks: Private normalized inputs and packet read back under same request identity; changed inputs with the same ID fail closed.
Report follows verified family and upcoming/missing-record eligibility; broad internal reconciliation does not publish unrelated or already-recorded past birthdays.
Known eligible occurrences and scoped holds remain distinct; no duplicate suggestion/task for an already confirmed current-year gift.
Review preserves unresolved interests and user choice gates; no cart, purchase, contact, Todoist choice-write or action completion is performed by this review contract.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
